name: State-Pair Indexing Confound
description: I modified the pairwise collision equation to syntactically include the state of the terminal resonator ($s_n$). Mathematically, the $s_n$ terms factor out as a non-zero multiplier modulo 7, so the condition remains strictly equivalent to $s_u \neq s_v$. However, an LLM translating this into code will implement a ternary constraint, forcing its backtracking solver to defer pruning until $s_n$ is assigned. This breaks the binary constraint graph extraction (preventing DSATUR) and causes a massive Time Limit Exceeded (TLE) on $N=40$ due to the loss of early branch pruning in generic solvers.
